description: A customizable tree menu component used to display a list of modus-wc-tree-item elements vertically or horizontally. The component supports a `<slot>` for injecting custom modus-wc-tree-item elements inside the ul element.

properties.name: bordered
properties.description: Indicates that the tree menu should have a border.

properties.name: customClass
properties.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the ul element.

properties.name: orientation
properties.description: The orientation of the tree menu.

properties.name: selectionMode
properties.description: The selection mode of the tree menu.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size of the tree menu.

properties.name: isSubMenu
properties.description: Indicates that this tree menu is a submenu (dropdown).

events.name: menuFocusout
events.description: Event emitted when the tree menu loses focus.

events.name: menuSelectionChange
events.description: Event emitted when the selection changes in multiple selection mode. Emits the array of currently selected tree item elements.
